jd.raw_text:
QA Engineer (Fresher) — QualiTech Systems, Gurugram

Join our QA team to test web and mobile applications before release.

Responsibilities:
- Design and execute manual test cases
- Log and track defects in JIRA
- Perform API testing with Postman
- Write SQL queries to validate data
- Follow SDLC and STLC processes

Required skills: manual testing, test case design, defect tracking, JIRA, SQL, API testing, SDLC, STLC.
Nice to have: Selenium automation, Python, CI/CD, performance testing.

Eligibility: B.Tech / BCA / MCA freshers with an eye for detail.
